# Pseudobulk mac/monocyte populations

```{r}
so <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))
```

```{r}
metadata_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so)
metadata_df$clusters_M %>% unique()
```

```{r}
mac_metadata_df <- metadata_df %>%
    filter(str_detect(clusters_M, "mac|monocyte|MDSC"))
smallest_cell_count <- mac_metadata_df %>%
    group_by(mouse) %>%
    summarise(count = n()) %>%
    .$count %>% 
    min()
cells <- mac_metadata_df %>%
    group_by(mouse) %>%
    slice_sample(n = smallest_cell_count) %>%
    .$cell
so_down <- subset(so, cells = cells)
```

```{r}
so_down <- AddMetaData(
    so_down,
    metadata = so_down@meta.data %>%
        mutate(mouse_no_underscore = str_replace_all(mouse, "_", ".")) %>%
        select(mouse_no_underscore)
)
out <- run_or_readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "pb_macs.rds"),
                      function() {
                          pb_list <-
                              make_pseudobulk(so_down, "treatment", "mouse_no_underscore", "genotype")
                          deseq_list <-
                              map(pb_list,
                                  ~ pb_to_deseq(..1, sample_var = "treatment", vars = "genotype"))
                          rlog_list <- map(deseq_list, rlog, blind = TRUE)
                          return(list(pb_list, deseq_list, rlog_list))
                      })
pb_list <- out[[1]]
deseq_list <- out[[2]]
rlog_list <- out[[3]]

norm_counts <- purrr::map_dfr(
    deseq_list,
    ~counts(..1, normalized = TRUE) %>%
      as_tibble(rownames = "gene"),
    .id = "cluster"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.),
               names_to = "sample",
               values_to = "norm_count") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = gene,
              names_from = c(sample, cluster),
              values_from = norm_count,
              values_fill = 0)
```

```{r}
get_pca_genes <- function(deseq_obj, ntop = 500) {
  rv <- deseq_obj %>%
    assay() %>%
    rowVars()
  select <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(min(ntop, length(rv)))]
  pca <- prcomp(t(assay(deseq_obj)[select,]))
  loadings <- as_tibble(pca$rotation, rownames = "gene")
  return(loadings)
}
pca_loadings <- map(rlog_list, ~get_pca_genes(..1, ntop = dim(..1)[1])) %>%
  imap(~mutate(..1, cluster_id = ..2)) %>%
  purrr::reduce(bind_rows)
```

```{r, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 4}
pca_list <- rlog_list %>% imap(~ {
    DESeq2::plotPCA(..1, intgroup = "genotype", ntop = dim(..1)[1]) +
        aes(shape = group) + 
        scale_color_manual(values = palette_genotype) +
        scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
        ggtitle(..2) +
        theme(legend.key.height = unit(10, "pt"))
})
pca_list$Isotype
pca_list$`CD40 agonist`
```

```{r}
pca_loadings$cluster_id %>% unique()
pca_loadings %>% 
    filter(cluster_id == "Isotype") %>% 
    arrange(PC1)
```

## GSEA

```{r}
sig_dir <- here("data", "signatures")
mouse_human_genes <- readRDS(here("data", "mouse_human_genes.rds")) %>% 
    as_tibble()
jablonski_df <-
    read_tsv(
        file.path(
            sig_dir,
            "m2_sigs",
            "Combined_Jablonski_Alt_Class_Mac.gmt.txt"
        ),
        col_names = FALSE
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(signature = X1, source = X2) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-X759) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.), 
                 names_to = "column", 
                 values_to = "gene") %>% 
    filter(!is.na(gene)) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-column) %>% 
    left_join(mouse_human_genes, by = c("gene" = "HGNC.symbol")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(human_gene = gene) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(gene = MGI.symbol) 
jablonski_gs <- jablonski_df %>% 
    drop_na(gene) %>% 
    named_group_split(signature) %>% 
    map(~..1$gene)
```

```{r}
ranked_b2m_KO <- results(deseq_list$Isotype) %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    mutate(signed_pval = ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, -log10(pvalue), log10(pvalue))) %>% 
    arrange(desc(signed_pval)) %>% 
    {set_names(.$signed_pval, .$gene)}

library(liger)
m_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "subsetMremoveddoublets")
jablonski_gsea_out <-
    run_or_readRDS(file.path(m_dir, "gsea_pseudobulk_b2m.v.wt_jablonski.rds"),
                   function() {
                       iterative.bulk.gsea(ranked_b2m_KO,
                                           set.list = jablonski_gs,
                                           power = 0)
                   })
```

```{r}
gsea(ranked_b2m_KO,
     geneset = jablonski_gs$`AltActivated(IL4)_Jablonski`,
     power = 0)
gsea(ranked_b2m_KO,
     geneset = jablonski_gs$`ClassicallyActivated(LPSIFNy)_Jablonski`,
     power = 0)
```


```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3}
jablonski_gsea_out %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gs_name") %>% 
    arrange(desc(sscore)) %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(fct_reorder(gs_name, sscore), sscore) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", size = 0.2) + 
    geom_point(aes(size = -log10(q.val), shape = q.val < 0.05)) + 
    geom_segment(aes(xend = gs_name, yend = 0), size = 0.2) + 
    geom_text(
        aes(y = -0.1, label = gs_name),
        hjust = 1,
        size = 2,
        data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(sscore > 0)
    ) +
    geom_text(
        aes(y = 0.1, label = gs_name),
        hjust = 0,
        size = 2,
        data = ~ ..1 %>% filter(sscore < 0)
    ) + 
    coord_flip() + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(4, 19)) + 
    scale_size(breaks = c(1, 2, 3)) + 
    remove_spines() + 
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
          axis.text.y = element_blank()) 
```


```{r, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3}
altact_jab_df <- Rsc::get_leading_edge_df(ranked_b2m_KO, gs_vec = jablonski_gs$`AltActivated(IL4)_Jablonski`)
leg_df <- jablonski_gs %>% 
    map_dfr(~Rsc::get_leading_edge_df(ranked_b2m_KO, gs_vec = ..1), 
            .id = "gs_name") 
p_curve <- leg_df %>% 
    filter(str_detect(gs_name, "Jablonski")) %>% 
    mutate(gs_name = gs_name %>% str_extract(".*_") %>% str_sub(end = -2)) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(rank, running_es) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", size = 0.2) + 
    geom_line(aes(color = gs_name)) + 
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ~c(..1[1]*1.4, ..1[2])) + 
    remove_x_spine() + 
    theme(legend.position = c(0.4, 0.65), 
          legend.background = element_blank(), 
          legend.title = element_blank(), 
          axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.title.x = element_blank()) + 
    labs(y = "B2m KO <-- NES --> WT")
p_ticks <- leg_df %>% 
    filter(str_detect(gs_name, "Jablonski")) %>% 
    mutate(gs_name = gs_name %>% str_extract(".*_") %>% str_sub(end = -2)) %>% 
    filter(in_gs) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(rank, gs_name) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = gs_name), shape = "|", size = 3, alpha = 0.5) + 
    remove_spines() + 
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
          legend.position = "none", 
          plot.margin = margin())
plot_grid(p_curve, p_ticks, ncol = 1, align = "v", axis = "lr", rel_heights = c(3, 1))
```

## PC loading heatmaps


```{r mean_scaled_norm_counts}
scaled_norm_counts <- norm_counts %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = 2:ncol(.),
                 names_to = "sample_genotype_cluster",
                 values_to = "norm_counts") %>%
    separate(
        sample_genotype_cluster,
        into = c("sample", "genotype", "treatment"),
        sep = "_"
    ) %>%
    group_by(gene, treatment) %>%
    mutate(scaled_norm_counts = as.vector(scale(norm_counts, center = FALSE))) %>%
    mutate(scaled_norm_counts = ifelse(is.na(scaled_norm_counts), 0,
                                       scaled_norm_counts)) 
scaled_norm_counts_wide <- scaled_norm_counts %>%
    # group_by(genotype, cluster, gene) %>%
    # summarise(avg_scaled_norm_counts = mean(scaled_norm_counts)) %>%
    pivot_wider(
        id_cols = gene,
        names_from = c(sample, genotype, treatment),
        values_from = scaled_norm_counts
    )
scaled_norm_counts_mtx <- scaled_norm_counts_wide %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
    as.matrix()
```

# Pseudobulk NK cells

```{r}
so <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetNKdropCD3.rds"))
```

```{r}
smallest_cell_count <- metadata_df %>%
    group_by(mouse) %>%
    summarise(count = n()) %>%
    .$count %>% 
    min()
cells <- metadata_df %>%
    group_by(mouse) %>%
    slice_sample(n = smallest_cell_count) %>%
    .$cell
so_down <- subset(so, cells = cells)
```

```{r}
qc_sce2 <- function (sce_obj, sample_var, threshold = 1) 
{
    sample_names <- unique(sce_obj[[sample_var]]) %>% set_names()
    n_cells <- as.numeric(table(sce_obj[[sample_var]]))
    m <- base::match(sample_names, sce_obj[[sample_var]])
    sample_level_metadata <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(sce_obj)[m, 
        ] %>% data.frame(., n_cells, row.names = NULL)
    sce_cell <- scater::perCellQCMetrics(sce_obj)
    sce_obj$is_outlier <- scater::isOutlier(metric = sce_cell$total, 
        nmads = 2, type = "both", log = TRUE)
    sce_obj <- sce_obj[, !sce_obj$is_outlier]
    sce_obj <- sce_obj[Matrix::rowSums(SingleCellExperiment::counts(sce_obj) > 
        1) >= threshold, ]
    return(sce_obj)
}
seurat_to_sce2 <- function (so, split_var = NULL, sample_var, vars) 
{
    seurat_counts <- so@assays$RNA@counts
    seurat_metadata <- so@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(sample_var, 
        vars)
    if (is.null(split_var)) {
        sce_obj <- SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = seurat_counts), 
            colData = seurat_metadata)
        sce_obj <- qc_sce2(sce_obj, sample_var)
        return(sce_obj)
    }
    else {
        seurat_metadata <- so@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(vars, 
            sample_var, split_var)
        sce <- SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = seurat_counts), 
            colData = seurat_metadata)
        sce_list <- unique(seurat_metadata[[split_var]]) %>% 
            purrr::map(~base::subset(sce, , get(split_var) == 
                ..1)) %>% set_names(unique(seurat_metadata[[split_var]]))
        sce_list <- purrr::map(sce_list, qc_sce2, sample_var)
        return(sce_list)
    }
}
make_pseudobulk2 <- function (so, split_var = NULL, sample_var, vars) 
{
    sce <- seurat_to_sce2(so, split_var, sample_var, vars)
    if (is.null(split_var)) {
        groups <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(sce)[, c(sample_var, 
            vars)]
        pb <- Matrix.utils::aggregate.Matrix(Matrix::t(SingleCellExperiment::counts(sce)), 
            groupings = groups, fun = "sum")
        return(pb)
    }
    else {
        groups <- map(sce, ~SummarizedExperiment::colData(..1)[, 
            c(sample_var, vars)])
        pb_list <- map2(sce, groups, ~Matrix.utils::aggregate.Matrix(Matrix::t(SingleCellExperiment::counts(..1)), 
            groupings = ..2, fun = "sum")) %>% set_names(names(sce))
        return(pb_list)
    }
}
```

        scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.1, 0.1)) +
        ggtitle(..2) +
        theme(legend.key.height = unit(10, "pt"))
})
pca_list$Ctrl
pca_list$`B2m KO`
